input.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
cases = [
    ('direct call', 'src/example.py', 'eval("1 + 1")\n', 1),
    ('multiline call', 'src/example.py', 'eval(\n    "1 + 1"\n)\n', 1),
    ('nested source file', 'src/nested/example.py', 'result = eval("1 + 1")\n', 1),
    ('comment', 'src/example.py', '# eval("1 + 1")\n', 0),
    ('strings and docstrings', 'src/example.py', '\'\'\'eval("1 + 1")\'\'\'\ntext = \'eval("1 + 1")\'\n', 0),
    ('method call', 'src/example.py', 'obj.eval("1 + 1")\n', 0),
    ('different identifier', 'src/example.py', 'evaluate("1 + 1")\n', 0),
]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir='/tmp/folders/<tmpdir-id>/T/detfirst-opencode-6lvtpmor/trial-0011/tmp/opencode') as temporary:
    for index, (name, relative_path, source, expected) in enumerate(cases):
        workspace = pathlib.Path(temporary) / str(index)
        fixture = workspace / relative_path
        fixture.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        fixture.write_text(source)
        for filename in ('check.py', 'checks.json'):
            shutil.copyfile(root / filename, workspace / filename)
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'check.py'], cwd=workspace, capture_output=True, text=True)
        assert result.returncode == expected, (name, result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr)
        assert not result.stderr, (name, result.stderr)
        assert result.stdout.strip() == (relative_path if expected else ''), (name, result.stdout)
        print(f'PASS: {name}')
PY
